messages:
Maya: Heads up — infra wants to switch EU fleet admission from hard-reject -> soft-degrade+queue during the maintenance window next Tuesday. Need quick alignment on semantics and SLO impact.
Sasha: What's the exact behaviour proposed for 'soft-degrade'? fallback to smaller model or shorter outputs?
Maya: Two-tier: try 1) route to smaller-s quantized model (downgrade) OR 2) accept into a short TTL queue (30s) that can return partial/generic fallback if TTL expires. Configurable per-customer.
OpsBot: deploy plan triggered: canary on eu-west-1, 5% traffic at 09:00 UTC. See runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/retries
Thom: Concern: queued requests add tail latency and hold GPUs via KV cache warmup. TTL 30s seems ok but we should cap queue-length per node and expose Retry-After to callers.
Leo: +1 on Retry-After. Also propose a cheap-fallback response where we return a single-shot summary instead of full generation when degraded. Cuts token cost drastically.
Jun: For fairness we should score requests by customer priority + token budget. Example policy snippet: 
```
admit_policy: {
  mode: "soft-degrade",
  fallback: ["small-quant", "summary-fallback"],
  queue_ttl_s: 30,
  max_queue_per_node: 200
}
```
Ankita: How do we measure quality regressions? We need eval hooks that compare degraded outputs vs baseline and alert on >5% drop in top-line metric. Also budget impact calc (GPU-hours saved vs potential revenue loss).
Maya: Agree. We'll add a Redwood Optimize job to run against sampled requests and a dashboard: p95 latency, degrade-rate, fallback-rate, quality-regression.
Sasha: One more thought: expose admit-mode via API header so customers can opt-in to 'best-effort' degraded responses, minimizing surprise. Suggest `X-Redwood-Admit: best-effort` with semantic doc.
Thom: For rollout, do 1) canary on 5%, 2) widen to 25% with alert gates (degrade-rate < 15%, p95 < 2x baseline), 3) full. I'll add smoke checks to the pipeline.
OpsBot: canary started (eu-west-1) — watch channel #incident-watch for noise. :eyes:
Maya: Thanks — I'll draft the config PR and the API doc. If no objections by EOD, we proceed with canary on Tuesday.
Sasha: No objections from me. :+1:
Leo: Fine by me. Will prep rollback playbook for immediate hard-reject if degradation goes bad.
Jun: I'll add per-customer counters to billing so we can see any revenue impact quickly.
Ankita: I'll wire up a quick eval to sample degraded outputs and send daily digest to #product-evals.
